scores.notes: Disciples in a slanting boat in heavy night seas, one bailing at the stern, water in the bilge, torn sail, moon and other boats; the halos are plain thin rings with no marks. Edges fully painted, hands and limbs read correctly.

Moses holds two staffs at once, a rod raised overhead in his right hand and a long crook in his left, while the water already pours from the rock. The flow also runs into a palm-lined river oasis rather than a dry camp; Aaron's breastplate and headband carry no glyphs.

Alice in blue dress and pinafore looks right toward a floating grin and eyes in the upper right; a flamingo lies at her feet, a hoop stands in the distance and a hedgehog walks off at right. No text, edges fully painted, flamingo and hands are well formed.

The shop board reads 'pawnbroker's balls', a second side board shows 'Nam…', and a signature sits in the bottom-right corner. Holmes is a clear Benedict Cumberbatch likeness, and he looks down at a pipe and magnifier rather than up at the house.

The slip Holmes holds, the letters on the desk and the newspapers at left and on the right wall all carry visible lines of text and headlines. Holmes is a Benedict Cumberbatch likeness and the seated Watson a Martin Freeman likeness, from the screen adaptation.

Holmes, gripping Watson's arm by the door, is a Benedict Cumberbatch likeness, and the newspapers on the floor and desk show columns of print. Wilson is lean and standing upright rather than stout and half-rising.

Naomi sits on a stool cradling the infant, with women of Bethlehem in an arc around her, plus a jar, a mat and an oil lamp in a mudbrick courtyard at dusk. All hands and faces are clean, with no text and no white edges.

Peter strides along the dry pebble beach carrying his coat as a bundle against his chest, rather than leaping from the boat into the sea. Jesus stands only a few paces away by the fire instead of being a distant figure; the beloved disciple pointing from the beached boat is fine.

Streaks of fire fall from a smoky sky onto a walled city in a valley at sunrise, with burning pits at right. The herder shielding his face stands large in the foreground rather than in the distance, but he was asked for and is well formed.

Aged Adam lies on a mat inside an open tent with family standing and kneeling on both sides, plus jars and an ash hearth, and open fields and hills through the doorway. The clustered hands near his head and the hands at his feet are coherent, with no text.

In watercolor, disciples walk up from a beached boat with a net and spilled fish toward a coal fire with fish and a loaf on it, and villagers stand in the background. Bare paper shows at the top-left sky and the bottom-right corner, which this style accepts.
Ezekiel stands small in the middle of a valley strewn with bones, arm raised; the tablet he holds is blank. The Lord's presence is only pale cloud light, with no figure anywhere in the sky.

Alice holds the bottle to her lips beside a glass table with a gold key, in a lamp-lit hall; the bottle's label is blank. The door at the end of the hall is full-size and open onto the garden rather than tiny and locked, a weak detail but not a wrong scene.

The camp shows three separate sanctuaries: a fenced tabernacle at left, a curtained tent at center that the cloud rises from, and a huge ornate cherub-curtained shrine at right. The single tabernacle under the cloud is therefore contradictory; edges are fully painted.

An empty flaming throne on burning wheels blazes in radiance above night-time Babylon, with no figure or face in the flames, and Daniel looks up from a rooftop at lower left. Corners are painted in dark wash with no blank paper.

Holmes, kneeling on the bed with cane and match toward the ventilator, is a Benedict Cumberbatch likeness, and Watson with the pistol is a Martin Freeman likeness. The top-left wall is left as bare white paper, which this style accepts.

Aaron, in ephod and breastplate with no glyphs, gestures toward a pig while Moses stands beside him with a crook. The crowd stands among rows of tents, with the tabernacle and its smoke in the distance; the pig and hands are well formed.

The wall hanging behind Saul's raised arm, upper left, is filled with rows of small script-like marks that read as an inscribed text. Otherwise the spear crosses the hall toward a dodging David beside a lyre, with no figure for the spirit.
Holmes at right is a clear Benedict Cumberbatch likeness, beside Hatherley pointing with a bandaged hand at the burning whitewashed house. The fire engine behind them is a motor truck from the 1920s.

A small card soldier in the misty middle distance, right of center, carries red diamond pips on its face, which are glyph marks on a card. The top-right corner fades to bare paper, which this style accepts; Alice, the flamingo, the hedgehog and the floating cat head are otherwise fine.

Moses holds two staffs, a tall one in his left hand and a short rod in his right. The people walk along a palm-lined shore beside a single wave, with open sea ahead, instead of on the sea floor between two walls of water.

Peter stands by the brazier in the high priest's torchlit courtyard with a rooster on the roof at top right, and a robed man across the colonnade faces him. Weak points: the staff stands loosely beside his open hand, and the Lord is not clearly identifiable.

The standing card soldier at left shows 'A' index letters and pips, and the other cards show pips. The arch-forming soldiers are men in striped harlequin suits with a curved card on their backs rather than flat cards, and metal hoops stand alongside them; a tiny solid square also sits in the top-left corner.

Peter grips the lame man's hand and pulls him up from the gate steps, with John beside him, onlookers and a priest at right before the temple gate and columns. The hands interlock coherently and the priest's headband is ornament, not script.

A priest in white linen beside a horned altar drops dark feathers onto a grey ash heap at right, with tabernacle curtains behind and onlookers at left. The curtain motifs are eagle-like ornament with no lettering.

The Hatter's pocket watch at center has a dial ringed with small numeral marks. Otherwise stern Alice faces the wide-eyed Hatter across a laden tea-table under a tree, with the March Hare pouring and the Dormouse asleep on the teapot.
